summary: Itron, Inc. filed an 8-K/A under Item 8.01 to update a prior disclosure regarding a cybersecurity incident involving unauthorized third-party access to certain systems, first disclosed on April 13, 2026. The company reports that operations continue materially unaffected, no further unauthorized activity has been observed, and limited access to customer-hosted systems was identified with no material impact to functionality. The filing provides no deal terms, price, premium, or advisory details. It is a routine operational update, not a special-situation filing. Cybersecurity disclosures under Item 8.01 are standard contingent reporting requirements.
